title: The Ice Witch
text: A witch of the Deep Cold, blue-lipped and beautiful, with frost growing on her eyelashes like lace. She offers to freeze a wound so it will never bleed again. Forever, she says, and touches her own chest, where something is frozen and does not beat.

options.label: The most wounded lets her freeze the wound, tempted by the promise of no more pain.

outcomes.text: It stops hurting. It stops feeling. It stops. They will never be quite warm there again.

options.label: Refuse her cold kiss. Some cures are worse than the wound.

outcomes.text: She shrugs and is gone in the snow, and her parting breath frosts every buckle in the party brittle.

options.label: The wisest trades her a secret instead, one cold thing for another.

outcomes.text: She smiles with blue lips, and gives a charm against the cold.
